non-blocking: display.promoted_node_count is compared with np.count_nonzero of the very mask the test handed to _panel_display_map, so both sides move together and the assertion reddens only on a truncation disagreement, never on a wrong promoted count; compare against the receipt's promoted_node_count at docs/figures/forward-solve-api/coil-edit-nonconvergence/panel-receipt.json instead.

non-blocking: nearest_promoted_to_xpoint_m is asserted only to be finite, so the done_when's 'measured to the polished saddle, not the seed' claim has no guard: reverting display_flux.py:381-382 to the seed distance leaves this assertion green, which is why the regression above is invisible to the node's own gate.
